t: Re - Two German Jewish Refugees Reported To Be Missing From Wayside District

pages.en:
13 MAR 1943

Wayside Misc.72/43 March, 2nd, 1943.

Re two German Jewish Refugees reported to be missing from Wayside District.

Sir,

At 9.00 p.m., 27-2-43, one named Melanie Weisler, residing at 226 Kungping Road, came to the station and reported that her brother named:

Hermann Natovic, age 33, German Jewish refugee, S/merchant, residing at 169 Chusan Road,
was missing from home since 4.00 p.m., 27-2-43.

At 10.30 p.m., 27-2-43, one named Irwin Schlesinger, residing at 909/3 East Seward Road, reported that his brother-in-law named:

Erich Seidel, age 30, German Jewish refugee, S/salesman, residing 80/26 Ward Road,
was missing since 1.30 p.m., 27-2-43.

At 1.30 p.m., 28-2-43, one named Mrs. Lovold, residing 150 Wayside Road, reported that her husband named:

Walter Lovold, age 37, German Jewish refugee, M/unemployed, residing above address,
was missing from home since 1.30 p.m., 27-2-43.

Enquiries by C.D.C.187 and the undersigned.

Preliminary enquiries revealed that Walter Lovold was arrested by D.S. Krader at 11.00 p.m., 27-2-43 and charged at this Station in connection with F.I.N.302/43 (W) and is now on a writ of detention. Message circulated cancelled.

Further enquiries revealed the following:

At about 3.00 p.m., 27-2-43, a male person, believed to be a Chinese, entered the "Rite Liqueurs" shop, owned by one S. Natovic, 169 Chusan Road, and asked the proprietor's son named Hermann Natovic the price of one bottle of "Cherry Brandy" and then enquiring about the price of one dozen bottles.

On agreeing to the price, the unknown person stated

1943年3月13日

路边区杂项案件 72/43号，1943年3月2日。

关于报告在路边区失踪的两名德籍犹太难民。

先生：

1943年2月27日晚上9时，一名名为梅拉妮·韦斯勒（Melanie Weisler）的女子，居住于公平路226号，来到警局报案称其兄弟：

赫尔曼·纳托维奇（Hermann Natovic），33岁，德籍犹太难民，职业为店员，居住于中山路169号，
自1943年2月27日下午4时起离家失踪。

1943年2月27日晚上10时30分，一名名为欧文·施莱辛格（Irwin Schlesinger）的男子，居住于东熙华德路909弄3号，报案称其姐夫：

埃里希·赛德尔（Erich Seidel），30岁，德籍犹太难民，职业为推销员，居住于华德路80弄26号，
自1943年2月27日下午1时30分起失踪。

1943年2月28日下午1时30分，一名名为洛沃尔德夫人（Mrs. Lovold）的女子，居住于威赛德路150号，报案称其丈夫：

瓦尔特·洛沃尔德（Walter Lovold），37岁，德籍犹太难民，职业为无业，居住于上述地址，
自1943年2月27日下午1时30分起离家失踪。

经刑事侦缉处第187号警探及本报告人调查。

初步调查显示，瓦尔特·洛沃尔德于1943年2月27日晚上11时被警佐克拉德（D.S. Krader）逮捕，因涉及案件 F.I.N.302/43 (W) 在本局被起诉，目前正凭拘留令羁押。已发出的协查通报予以撤销。

进一步调查揭示如下情况：

1943年2月27日下午3时许，一名男子（据信为华人）进入位于中山路169号、由 S. 纳托维奇所有的“Rite Liqueurs”酒行，并向店主之子赫尔曼·纳托维奇询问一瓶“樱桃白兰地”的价格，随后又询问一打瓶装的价格。

在就价格达成一致后，该不明身份者表示

（印：受付 18.3.3.）

that he would inform his master of the prices as he opening
a new provision shop at the corner of Haining and North Szechuer
roads.

The unknown person then left the shop and after an elapse
of about 15 minutes a telephone call was received by Hermann
Natovic from the unknown person requesting that he should bring
a sample to the shop to show to his master. On Hermann inform-
ing the unknown person that he would send his boy with the
sample, the unknown person stated that he should better come
himself as it would possibly be a large order.

Natovic then took three samples of liquor and left to
the designated shop.

At about 3.20 p.m., 27-2-43, a further telephone call
was received from the unknown person enquiring if Hermann had
left with the samples. On being informed by a relative of his
that he had already left, the unknown person replied "all right"
and cut off.

At about 3.25 p.m., 27-2-43, Hermann returned to his shop
and stated that due to the blocking of the streets he was
unable to continue on his journey.

On being informed that the unknown person had telephoned
enquiring if he had left, Hermann immediately hired a public
ricsha and left again.

At about 4.00 p.m., 27-2-43, Helene Natovic received a
telephone call from Hermann who after stating that he was
telephoning from a shop nearby informed her that he was unable
to locate the shop and informed her that should the unknown
person call again to inform him that he was unable to locate
the place and meet him the next day at his shop; "Elite".

Natovic then suddenly stated that the unknown person was
standing next to him and then he cut the connection, and he
was not heard of since.

Helene was instructed to search the belongings of Hermann
in an endeavour if possible to find a clue which might lead to
the cause of his disappearance.

拐角处开设一家新的食品杂货店。

随后该不明身份者离开店铺，约15分钟后，赫尔曼·
纳托维奇接到该不明身份者的电话，要求他带样品到店里
给其主人看。当赫尔曼告知该不明身份者他将派伙计送样
品去时，该不明身份者称最好亲自前来，因为可能是一笔
大订单。

纳托维奇随即携带三种酒类样品，前往指定的店铺。

1943年2月27日下午3时20分许，再次接到该不明身
份者的电话，询问赫尔曼是否已携带样品出发。当其亲属
告知他已出发后，该不明身份者回答“好的”并挂断电话。

1943年2月27日下午3时25分许，赫尔曼回到店内，
称由于街道阻塞，他无法继续前行。

当得知该不明身份者曾来电询问他是否已出发后，赫
尔曼立即雇了一辆公共人力车再次出发。

1943年2月27日下午4时许，海伦娜·纳托维奇
（Helene Natovic）接到赫尔曼的电话，赫尔曼称他是从附
近一家商店打的电话，并告知她他找不到那家商店，还让
她如果该不明身份者再打电话来，就告知对方他找不到地
方，并约定第二天在他的“Elite”酒行见面。

纳托维奇突然称该不明身份者就站在他旁边，随后切
断了通话，此后便杳无音信。

海伦娜奉命搜查赫尔曼的随身物品，试图寻找可能揭
示其失踪原因的线索。

an envelope on which was written in capital letters N.B.

In the envelope was found a map which seemed to the
undersigned to be a sketch of a transmitting set.

Questioned as to the origin of the envelope and
plan, the following was ascertained.

In the a.m. on or about the 24-2-43, a telephone
call was received by Hermann from a person who called
himself Mr. Weinberg, and after stating that he was speak-
ing on behalf of Mr. Farren, owner of a cabaret at 325
Great Western Road, instructed Hermann to go to the above
cabaret and offer liquors.

On instructions of Hermann, Seidal, who is also
reported missing and employed as a salesman by Hermann,
immediately proceeded who on interviewing Farren was
informed by the latter that he had at no time contemplated
or instructed any person to telephone and order liquors.

On or about the 26-2-43, Halone was informed by
Seidal to the effect that there an envelope on which was
written N.B.16085 which was lying in the shop would be
claimed by somebody.

Next to the telephone in the shop was found written
in the handwriting of Hermann 16085 and Jimmy Kitchen.

As the undersigned is not a radio expert, Mr.Joseph
Hahn, radio engineer, operating the Arena Radio Shop, 730

根据赫尔曼的指示，同样报告失踪且受雇于赫尔曼担

At this instance Helma Natovic entered the detec-

On the instructions of the Officer in-charge, the
film, envelope and the radio book was handed over to

As Mr. Hata wanted his book returned, Sergeant Ozaki

At 10.30 a.m., 2-3-43, a telephone message was
received by D.S.I. Tanaka from Sergeant Ozaki to the
effect that if the relatives of Hermann Natovic had
received a note of paper in which was written in English
"We are safe".

D.S.I. Tanaka and the undersigned proceeded to the
Elite Liquours Shop, 169 Chusan Road, and on enquiries
made ascertained that no such letter was received, but
they stated that at about 6.15 p.m., 28-2-43 a telephone
call was received from Hermann Natovic to the effect that
he was well and requested that food and clothing be sent
to him. He further stated that he would be released the

上述案件中。

此时赫尔玛·纳托维奇（Helma Natovic，原文拼写可
能与前文 Helene 为同一人或亲属）进入侦探办公室，认出
渡边先生就是那位来为其主人购买酒类的不明身份者。

根据主管警官的指示，胶卷、信封和无线电书籍连同
上述第一、第二名人员一并移交给尾崎警佐，因为他承认
他们是作为线人为宪兵队效力。

由于畑先生（Mr. Hata，此处人名与前文 Hahn 不一致，
依原文译出）想要回他的书，主管警官将此情况告知尾崎
警佐，并承诺次日归还，随后也如约履行。

1943年3月2日上午10时30分，日籍警佐田中接到尾
崎警佐的电话留言，大意是询问赫尔曼·纳托维奇的亲属
是否收到一张纸条，上面用英文写着“We are safe”（我们
很安全）。

日籍警佐田中和本报告人前往中山路169号的 Elite
Liquours 酒行，经查询获悉并未收到此类信件，但他们表
示在1943年2月28日下午6时15分左右，曾接到赫尔曼·纳
托维奇的电话，称他一切安好，并要求送去食物和衣物。
他还表示将于次日，即1943年3月1日获释。

1943年2月28日下午6时30分左右，赫尔曼的妹妹梅
拉妮·迈斯特（Melanie Meister）前往桥畔大厦（Bridge
House），并移交了
